scope.concern: Web standalone XSS, localStorage tamper, input sanitization, leak across pages, secrets exposure

summary: Pure React render via JSX (auto-escaped). No dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere. No eval. No new innerHTML calls. localStorage NOT used (verified via grep — sole hit is README docs reference). Cart + auth state purely React. No secrets/keys/tokens in source. CDN scripts (react/react-dom/babel) have SRI integrity hashes (line index.html:14-16). Promo input + notes textarea + OTP code = controlled inputs, value rendered directly through React (escaped). All buttons/links use static href except a few hard-coded contact/social placeholders ('#').

findings_p2.title: Anchor href='#' without rel='noopener noreferrer' for @lecayenne_ external link
findings_p2.evidence: screens.jsx:284 <a className="lc-btn lc-btn--ink" target="_blank" href="#">@lecayenne_ — target=_blank without rel=noopener leaks window.opener if # becomes a real URL
findings_p2.recommendation: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to any future <a target="_blank">. Currently href="#" so risk is theoretical, but defensive default.

findings_p2.title: Demo card data hardcoded in payment form state (PaymentPage initial useState)
findings_p2.evidence: funnel.jsx:238 useState({ num: '4242 4242 4242 4242', exp: '12/28', cvc: '123', name: 'IKYES BENZAID' }) — sample Stripe test card visible in source. Not a secret but bad UX habit if cloned to prod with real card.
findings_p2.recommendation: Replace defaults with empty strings + placeholder attrs only. Demo PII (name) → 'NOM PRENOM'.

findings_p3.title: Babel-standalone in production = 1MB+ JIT compile each load
findings_p3.evidence: index.html loads @babel/standalone CDN. Acceptable for standalone preview; not production hardening but should be flagged for V1.1 build pipeline (Vite).
findings_p3.recommendation: Defer to V1.1 build pipeline (per README). No action this cycle.

verdict: SEC OK. Zero P0/P1. JSX-only rendering = automatic XSS escape. SRI on CDN. Two P2 cosmetic (demo card + noopener) flagged backlog. No secrets in source.
